image_description: A dimly lit interior view of a prison cell block, featuring two levels of walkways with metal railings on either side. The walls are distressed concrete or plaster with peeling paint. In the background, vertical bars of cells are visible. The perspective leads down a central corridor towards a darker area.

artifact_observations.location: Upper left wall and ceiling junction
artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the peeling paint and wall surface appears slightly smudged or 'painted over' rather than having distinct physical depth, typical of AI generation struggling with complex decay textures.

The geometry at the far end of the hallway becomes indistinct and logically ambiguous. The bars and walls seem to merge without a clear termination point or door, suggesting a failure in long-range structural coherence.
The vertical posts of the railing on the right show slight inconsistency in spacing and alignment relative to the perspective vanishing point, appearing slightly warped.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is classified as a prison/correctional facility and not a generic industrial hallway or bunker.
To verify the 3D consistency of the parallel walkways and ensure the background depth does not exhibit melting or spatial contradictions.
To check if the thin metal bars and railings maintain continuous connectivity without fusing into the walls or breaking inexplicably.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the repeating cell bars

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the background depth. AI often fails to render the end of long corridors correctly, resulting in nonsensical geometry. Also, inspect the connection points of the railings to the walls for fusion artifacts.
